projectBriefConcise: Single Storey Extension to rear of Existing House, First Floor Addition on top of the Existing Garage and Utility Room, upgrades to the Existing Greenhouse.
projectBriefFull:
## Project Overview And Goals
The primary aim is to create more living space and modernise the property with a high end transitional contemporary design. The project involves a ground floor extension, a first floor extension over the existing garage, and internal reconfigurations. The intended use is for luxury family living and integrated outdoor entertaining. 


## Proposed Ground Floor Alterations
The ground floor extension will total around 44 to 50 square metres. It features a contemporary flat roof structure connecting to the existing bay window via a glazed link. This glazed link will include a glass wall section, a glass roof panel, a step up to the new flat roof, and a potential reading nook. 

The existing utility and WC area will be reconfigured to incorporate a new wet room while maintaining or increasing storage capacity of the current utility room. 

A new internal corridor will provide direct access to the future indoor Pool House through a sealed door with gaskets. In the first instance, this will be an indoor hot tub room, but if a pool is installed at a later date, an air handling system should be installed. 

An alteration to the current lounge removing the solid wall across from the staircase replacing it with a new glazed wall system added to the right hand side of the entrance hallway as you walk in from the main entrance door at the front of the house.


## Proposed First Floor Alterations
The current master bedroom will be extended over the garage to establish a complete luxury suite. This new space will include a walk in wardrobe, a dressing area, space for a king size bed, and an upgraded en suite bathroom.

The front of the first floor extension will be set back slightly from the front of the house, and the styling of the front of the first floor master bedroom extension will be to match the more ornate traditional style of the front of the house. 

The first floor extension over the current garage and utility room will utilise a lightweight structure, insulated internally to achieve necessary thermal insulation values without requiring planning permission for demolition. 


## Design Style And Key Features
The architectural style is high end and contemporary. The new extension will have a modern GRP flat roof and feature three sets of three panel bi folding doors. The roof will incorporate three Korniche style roof lanterns. The outdoor area will be heavily landscaped for contemporary outdoor living, featuring ample lounging space arranged around a fire pit.
